messages:
maria: CI nightly posted a latency alert for the side-by-side synthetic vs replay benchmark. p95 jumped ~18% on the replay harness for the new kernel selector change. link: https://dash.redwood.local/r/bench/1845678 :eyes:
ci-bot: alert: nightly/bench/side-by-side failed threshold (p95 > 140ms). run_id=run-20260317-09 sha=3f2a1b7
raj: saw it, digging in. quick note: synthetic runs stable, replay shows the regression. could be KV-cache warmup or batching difference.
kevin: I downloaded the replay traces. two suspects: (1) kernel fallback to generic matmul on A100 for some layer shapes, (2) batching heuristic picked smaller batches for chunked sequences.
kevin: small snippet I ran locally to reproduce:
```
./harness/replay_runner --run-id run-20260317-09 --model gpt-xx --profile --kv-cache=on --batching-mode=adaptive
```
kevin: repro gives p95 ~155ms (baseline 130ms).
dana: did we change the kernel selector in the last rollout? I thought that patch only added a tie-break rule.
maria: PR 4823 adjusted kernel ranking to prefer quantized kernels when available. that may have bumped some layers to a different codepath.
oliver: also worth checking the kvcache eviction policy; replay has lots of prefix reuse, synthetic doesn't. if the new selector added extra per-token work, cache misses amplify it.
raj: logged a profiler capture: https://internal.artifacts/repro/3f2a1b7/profile.html - looks like 14% more time in 'matmul_generic' and 6% more in 'kv_read_lock' during warmup.
kevin: interesting, the matmul_generic is used only for shape (128, 64) in this model. kernel DB says we should have had optimized kernel for that shape, but selector returned "generic" due to ranking score change.
maria: action: rollback ranking tweak in a canary branch and re-run nightly side-by-side with replay. can someone trigger a smoke CI?
raj: triggering now. command I used: `ci run-nightly --suite side-by-side --target replay --commit 3f2a1b7 --env=staging`
ci-bot: job queued: job-7894. will post results when complete. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: if rollback fixes it, we need a test in CI to catch kernel-selection regressions. idea: add a tiny matrix of layer shapes that maps to kernel DB and assert no fallback to generic for those shapes during apples-to-apples runs.
dana: agree. also add a KV-cache warmup stage in the replay harness to stabilize variance — something like pre-play 50 prefixes. synthetic harness should mirror that warmup to be comparable.
maria: good notes. let's also add a flaky-test label on the nightly alert while we triage so on-call isn't paged repeatedly. raj, can you update the alert policy?
raj: done: set to notify-slim for 1 hour and auto-suppress duplicates. added run_id and sha in alert body.
oliver: for dashboards: publish a split view (synthetic vs replay) and show kernel selection distribution per layer. that will make future regression root-cause faster. I'll add a panel: kernel.selector.counts by layer shape. linked to the run: https://dash.redwood.local/r/bench/1845678/panels/kernel-distribution
kevin: temporary mitigation: pin kernel ranking to previous commit in Dedicated for critical customers until we confirm. I'll open a follow-up PR to pin and add unit test for ranking comparator.
maria: summary of action items: (1) raj - collect full profiler exports for the failing run and attach to bug; (2) kevin - rollback kernel-ranking in canary and run smoke; (3) dana - add kv-cache warmup stage + replay harness parity changes; (4) oliver - add dashboard panel; (5) kevin - open PR for kernel ranking test + pin in Dedicated.
dana: tagging infra: @kevin @raj if you need larger replay capacity for runs later today.
kevin: thx. will update thread when the rollback smoke completes. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: job-complete: job-7894 status=failed p95=153ms (threshold 140ms) artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/run-7894
maria: ok rollback smoke still failing -> hypothesis shift: maybe regression is only visible under replay sequence distribution + kv-cache concurrency. we should run with `--kv-sync=lockless` to rule out lock contention.
raj: queued a run with lockless mode and full profiler. run_id=run-20260317-10. will post results.
kevin: thanks. appreciate the fast triage.
